description: The Cortina U4 Solid is the icon of Cortina, made even more robust. Specially designed for those who expect more from a transport bike, the Cortina U4 Solid combines the iconic elegant design with an extra sturdy frame for added security. This transport bike makes your ride significantly more comfortable. You can carry plenty with the extra strong rear rack, and the AVS front rack allows you to easily and quickly click on a basket or crate, giving your bike a personal touch. For advice, a test ride, and ordering a bike, you can visit one of our Cortina stores.
